about: S4b-BL-116 Drive backups: retention (7 daily, 4 weekly, 6 monthly, the shrink guard) and the automatic schedule. Times are epoch milliseconds; utcOffsetMinutes is the device's offset east of UTC. Read by BackupVectorsTest (Kotlin) and backup-vectors.spec.ts (TypeScript); written by an independent Python implementation.

retention.name: a week of daily backups: all kept
a year of daily backups keeps 13: the buckets overlap
retention.note: 7 days, then the newest of each older week and month; at most 17

retention.name: several a day: the newest of each day
days are local: 23:00 UTC is the next day in India
the same backups at UTC fall on one day
ties in time go by id
sparse monthly backups over two years keep six months
shrink guard: the newest has 3 houses after 48, nothing is pruned
shrink guard confirmed: pruning goes on
a wiped phone's five small backups still hold
after a confirm the same level does not ask again
a further drop after a confirm holds again
a dip that recovered does not hold
exactly half is not a drop
one house to none is a drop

schedule.name: manual runs even when automatic is off
a full Drive waits a day
a full Drive after a day
refused grant waits for a connect
manual runs after a blocked failure
a skew under five minutes is not a change
an attempt in the future does not hold a retry
